summary: The implementation successfully addresses all core requirements. The backend includes a complete product data model with all requested fields, query methods for filtering by category, price range, and rating, and 10 sample products (slightly below the requested 15-20). The frontend features a responsive product grid, comprehensive filtering sidebar with category checkboxes, price slider, and rating selection, and a modern e-commerce design theme with warm color palette. The architecture uses Motoko for backend (single-actor), React with TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS as specified.

missing_requirements.requirement: At least 15-20 sample products are pre-loaded
missing_requirements.reason: Only 10 sample products are seeded in backend/main.mo, falling short of the minimum 15 products specified in the acceptance criteria

hallucinated_features.reason: User authentication was explicitly listed as a non-goal, yet the implementation includes useInternetIdentity hook, InternetIdentityProvider, and authentication-related query logic in useActor.ts

hallucinated_features.description: Navigation menu with Products, Categories, and About links
hallucinated_features.reason: Multi-page navigation was not requested; the requirement was for a product catalog with filtering, suggesting a single-page view

hallucinated_features.description: Social media footer links (X, Facebook, Instagram)
hallucinated_features.reason: Social media integration was not mentioned in any requirements
